purpose: same-state short-horizon opportunity-cost diagnostic before a natural-search confirmation

model.service_acceptance_required: the existing full planner/coder acceptance record must be referenced at freeze

selection.incumbent: lowest valid continuation-block validation loss in the fixed source prefix
selection.branch: valid node with loss strictly above incumbent and within 0.035 loss units, and behavior distance above 0.08
selection.missing_branch: record preparation_incomplete; do not substitute a later node or inspect continuation outcomes

C-I.name: incumbent_development
C-I.later_steps: develop the best valid child on the incumbent project; update global incumbent independently

C-B.name: branch_development
C-B.step_0: develop the frozen quality-close behavior-different branch
C-B.later_steps: continue the branch investment project through locally improving children; do not relabel a behavior cell as a new budget project

C-E.name: explore_then_develop
C-E.later_steps: develop the first valid exploration result and its locally improving children
C-E.invalid_exploration: consume the step; later steps remain parentless exploration and are marked explore_followup_not_started

actions.common_budget: exactly four proposals per job and at most eight model requests; invalid or truncated proposals consume their proposal slot

state_contract.behavior_cell_id: diagnostic behavior grouping; may change after a proposal
state_contract.investment_id: stable project identity inherited by valid locally improving children
state_contract.lineage_id: immutable ancestor ledger for cost and duplicate-budget accounting
state_contract.global_incumbent: best valid node over the complete checkpoint plus continuation
state_contract.branch_project: separate from behavior_cell_id; no automatic budget reset on behavior change
state_contract.exploration_project: created only by a valid C-E step 0 result

endpoints.primary: test loss improvement over the checkpoint incumbent under equal four-proposal budgets
secondary: whether continuation project crossed a behavior-cell boundary
endpoints.opportunity_cost: C-B or C-E is valuable only when its test improvement exceeds C-I from the same block-phase checkpoint after equal cost accounting
endpoints.unit_of_inference: data block; early and late checkpoints are paired within block; repetitions are within-checkpoint repeats

isolation.test_access: only after all live jobs reach a terminal status
isolation.test_selection: best validation node after four proposals; test is never read during selection
isolation.fresh_data: blocks 52-59 must have no ID or exact-coordinate overlap with blocks 3-51
isolation.analysis: report block-paired differences and descriptive block bootstrap; do not treat 96 jobs or 384 proposals as independent experiments

generation.provider_failure: terminate only the affected job, preserve partial records, and retain an explicit infrastructure_incomplete status
generation.global_pause: reuse the provider diagnostics and global pause gate from E1/E2; never dispatch remaining jobs after a frozen global halt

freeze_rules.claims: diagnostic evidence about conditional opportunity cost only; this study cannot establish universal superiority or the final Chapter 6 method

required_offline_checks: source study manifest and every source run hash are recorded
all 16 checkpoint identities and source steps are frozen before any continuation response
early and late checkpoints have independent data snapshot hashes
each checkpoint has a valid incumbent and an explicitly eligible branch or a preparation_incomplete record
C-E fixture test confirms step 0 exploration followed by development of its valid result
invalid C-E step 0 fixture test confirms no fabricated parent or budget reset
request and proposal counts are exactly 8 and 4 per job respectively
no test split is loaded by preparation or live continuation
